import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex
import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Biproducts

/-!
# Cohomology of a pair of simplicial cochain complexes
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {K L : SSet}

/-- Projection to the first cochain factor of the pair complex. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainPairFst :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex K L ⟶ integralSimplicialCochainComplex K :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst ℤ _ _)) (by
    intro n
    simp only [integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex, integralSimplicialCochainComplex,
      CochainComplex.of_d]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl)

/-- Projection to the second cochain factor of the pair complex. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex K L ⟶ integralSimplicialCochainComplex L :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd ℤ _ _)) (by
    intro n
    simp only [integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex, integralSimplicialCochainComplex,
      CochainComplex.of_d]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl)

/-- Inclusion of the first cochain factor into the pair complex. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainPairInl :
    integralSimplicialCochainComplex K ⟶ integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex K L :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.inl ℤ _ _)) (by
    intro n
    simp only [integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex, integralSimplicialCochainComplex,
      CochainComplex.of_d]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl)

/-- Inclusion of the second cochain factor into the pair complex. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainPairInr :
    integralSimplicialCochainComplex L ⟶ integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex K L :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.inr ℤ _ _)) (by
    intro n
    simp only [integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex, integralSimplicialCochainComplex,
      CochainComplex.of_d]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl)

@[simp] theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairFst_f (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPairFst (K := K) (L := L)).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst ℤ _ _) := rfl

@[simp] theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd_f (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd (K := K) (L := L)).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd ℤ _ _) := rfl

@[simp] theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairInl_f (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPairInl (K := K) (L := L)).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.inl ℤ _ _) := rfl

@[simp] theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairInr_f (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPairInr (K := K) (L := L)).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.inr ℤ _ _) := rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairInl_fst :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairInl (K := K) (L := L) ≫
      integralSimplicialCochainPairFst = 𝟙 _ := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairInl_snd :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairInl (K := K) (L := L) ≫
      integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd = 0 := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairInr_fst :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairInr (K := K) (L := L) ≫
      integralSimplicialCochainPairFst = 0 := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPairInr_snd :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairInr (K := K) (L := L) ≫
      integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd = 𝟙 _ := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainPair_total :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairFst (K := K) (L := L) ≫
        integralSimplicialCochainPairInl +
      integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd ≫ integralSimplicialCochainPairInr = 𝟙 _ := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact add_zero x.1
  · exact zero_add x.2

/-- Homology carries the pair complex to the biproduct of the two cohomologies. -/
def integralSimplicialCohomologyPairBiprodIso (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex K L).homology n ≅
      IntegralSimplicialCohomology K n ⊞ IntegralSimplicialCohomology L n where
  hom := biprod.lift (homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairFst n)
    (homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd n)
  inv := biprod.desc (homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairInl n)
    (homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairInr n)
  hom_inv_id := by
    rw [biprod.lift_desc, ← homologyMap_comp, ← homologyMap_comp,
      ← homologyMap_add, integralSimplicialCochainPair_total, homologyMap_id]
  inv_hom_id := by
    apply biprod.hom_ext' <;> apply biprod.hom_ext <;>
      simp [← homologyMap_comp]

theorem integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_eq_pair :
    ∀ {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex),
    integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B =
      integralSimplicialCochainPairFst ≫
          integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) -
        integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd ≫
    integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) := by
  intro K A B
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  rfl

theorem integralSimplicialCohomologyIntersectionDifference_eq_pair (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex),
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n =
      homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairFst n ≫
          homologyMap
            (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left)) n -
        homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd n ≫
          homologyMap
            (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right)) n := by
  intro K A B
  rw [integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_eq_pair]
  rw [homologyMap_sub, homologyMap_comp, homologyMap_comp]

theorem integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_fst :
    ∀ {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex),
    integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B ≫
        integralSimplicialCochainPairFst =
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) := by
  intro K A B
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  rfl

theorem integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_snd :
    ∀ {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex),
    integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B ≫
        integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd =
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) := by
  intro K A B
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCohomologyUnionRestriction_fst (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex),
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n ≫
        homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairFst n =
      homologyMap
        (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left)) n := by
  intro K A B
  rw [← homologyMap_comp, integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_fst]

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCohomologyUnionRestriction_snd (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex),
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n ≫
        homologyMap integralSimplicialCochainPairSnd n =
      homologyMap
        (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right)) n := by
  intro K A B
  rw [← homologyMap_comp, integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_snd]

end Mumford.Analytic
